risks: Root-owned wave0/shared changes can invalidate line ranges/hashes. References are live working-tree evidence, not certified input-HEAD source; no automatic overwrite or stale patch application.
A table of notes and fixed counters is not a spreadsheet. Reusing Notes localStorage would falsely imply durable multi-user workbook support.
ContentKind and descriptor authority currently reject sheets, and PageConfig has no workbook descriptor. Silent markdown/HTML fallback risks destructive conversions or two stores.
Current member-of relation excludes page despite existing projectId. Project Documents must resolve one approved canonical relationship, not independent page/project membership copies.
Source-action PageActionGrant is not collaboration read/write/share ACL. Viewer/revoke checks must live in server authority and apply to pending ops, subscriptions, caches and agent transports.

A1 must never become cell identity. Offline edits against deleted row/column IDs must preserve only authorized draft content, never resurrect tombstoned structure; formulas need stable-ID references and deterministic rebase.
CSV alone does not distinguish text from decimal/date/boolean/null or formulas. An explicit reversible typed mapping is necessary to meet no-type-loss acceptance without secretly weakening it.

Expression length/depth/range and paste limits are not numerically fixed in this specification. Lead must finalize them and engine dependency/license before implementation; Excel/XLSX/Pivot parity is outside the specified scope, not an excuse to omit SUM/AVERAGE/IF/direct refs.

Shared transport/editor/search/outbox locations were not inferred from filenames. Dependency owners must provide accepted seams; a type declaration or create button alone cannot close an integration criterion.
Full-feature acceptance cannot use the spec's UI-only N/A clause to omit persistence/concurrency/policy. Every AC and DoD is retained as unimplemented/unverified in this report.
No runtime or native evidence is claimed. This preflight is not feature implementation, a passing test receipt, Linux/native proof, migration proof or independent final review.
